task_description: Phase 5 implementation: Chat hardening (server RPC, rate limit, word filter, mute list), Fishing mini-game (timing-based mechanic, biome-specific catches, new items), and Collection/Museum system (item donation tracking, category rewards, new NPC Curator Milo). All features extend existing ECS/inventory/quest patterns and remain locally testable without Supabase credentials.

verification.summary: 719 tests passing (29 shared + 12 database + 365 game-engine + 313 web). pnpm build, lint, and format:check all green. Review fixes applied: word-boundary anchors in migration 006, CollectionSystem quest integration, FishingSystem reel-time catch roll with overflow handling, rate-limit index added.

issues_fixed: Word filter uses \m/\M word-boundary anchors to prevent compound-word false positives
CollectionSystem now requires quest component and calls recordDonation on successful donate
FishingSystem rolls catch at reel-time and checks hasSpaceFor before awarding
Added idx_chat_messages_sender_recent index for rate-limit query performance
tests_added: CollectionSystem -> quest integration path (2 new tests)
FishingSystem overflow handling when rolled catch has no space (1 new test)
Word filter compound-word assertion in verify-sql.sh (scrapyard/grasshopper)
